_readme: S739 (the pooled reading's next, lane 1). Two Modesto Junior records plan s731p held. Respiratory Care A.S. (06683): the printed 75.5-77.5 includes a 15-unit block 'TO EARN AN ASSOCIATE IN SCIENCE DEGREE IN RESPIRATORY CARE' of MJC general education areas 1B, 2, 3, 6 and 7 that the record leaves out (its note); a Modesto reconcile fill of ge_units from that block's own words is the lever, and this read prints the words. Spanish AA-T (35127): the description lays out two learner paths (non-native; native or heritage) the eLumen structure does not encode, and the page prints 19-23; this read prints the paths' words. The catalog's own publish calls, as the harvest's capture reads them. Two loads, no model call, nothing written.

questions.ge_block: How the Respiratory Care page prints the block 'TO EARN AN ASSOCIATE IN SCIENCE DEGREE IN RESPIRATORY CARE', its total and its general education areas.
questions.learner_paths: How the Spanish AA-T page words its two learner paths, and which courses and unit figures each path prints.
